nodes.description: Public uint256 total token supply, written in the VinzCoin constructor.
mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) storing allowances, written by approve and transferFrom.
Public string token name set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value set once in the constructor.
Public string token symbol set once in the constructor.
Private constant 2**256-1 used as the infinite-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
Constructor: assigns the whole initial supply to msg.sender and sets name/decimals/symbol.
Public transfer: decrements balances[msg.sender] and increments balances[_to] without SafeMath.
Public transferFrom: moves tokens using an allowance and mutates balances and allowed.
Public view returning balances[_owner].
Public approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Public view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance key and as the recipient of the initial supply.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer: unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
balances[_to] += _value in transfer: unchecked addition that can overflow.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom: unchecked addition that can overflow.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction of the allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value in approve: unrestricted caller-controlled allowance write.
Constructor parameter for the initial token supply.
Constructor parameter for the token name.
Constructor parameter for the decimals value.
Constructor parameter for the token symbol.
transfer recipient address parameter.
transfer amount parameter.
transferFrom recipient address parameter.
transferFrom source address parameter.
transferFrom amount parameter.
balanceOf owner address parameter.
approve spender address parameter.
approve allowance amount parameter.
allowance owner address parameter.
allowance spender address parameter.
Local uint256 allowance = allowed[_from][msg.sender] cached in transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount, granting the whole supply to the deployer.
Constructor assigns totalSupply = _initialAmount.
msg.sender is used as the key into the balances mapping.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] with no overflow check.
msg.sender determines whose balance is decremented by the unchecked subtraction.
The unchecked balance decrement executes inside transfer and determines its success.
Attacker-chosen _to receives _value via an unchecked addition.
Caller-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] without overflow protection.
transfer mutates the balances mapping twice with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom first caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] into the local allowance variable.
msg.sender is part of the allowance lookup key in transferFrom.
_from is part of the allowance lookup key in transferFrom.
The MAX_UINT256 sentinel guard if(allowance < MAX_UINT256) decides whether the allowance is decremented.
The cached allowance is decremented without a safe subtraction check.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from the stored allowance.
msg.sender selects the allowance slot that is decremented.
Caller-supplied _from has its balance decremented by an unchecked subtraction.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[_from].
Caller-supplied _to has its balance increased by an unchecked addition.
Caller-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping with unchecked additions and subtractions.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
msg.sender defines the owner index written by approve.
Caller-chosen _spender becomes the spender index in the allowance write.
Caller-chosen _value is stored as the spender allowance without validation.
The arbitrary allowance assignment is the core effect of approve.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner] for the supplied owner address.
approve writes the allowed mapping keyed by msg.sender and _spender.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender] using the supplied owner.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender] using the supplied spender.
msg.sender is the owner key for the allowed mapping, so any caller can set its own allowances.

normalization_plan.reason: _initialAmount only feeds the constructor assignments of balances and totalSupply.
_tokenName is only stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
_decimalUnits is only stored into the decimals state variable by the constructor.
_tokenSymbol is only stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_to is the recipient index of the unchecked balances[_to] += _value addition.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= _value subtraction.
_to is the recipient index of the unchecked balances[_to] += _value addition.
_from is the source index of the unchecked balances[_from] -= _value subtraction.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
_owner is only used to read balances[_owner] inside balanceOf.
_spender is the spender index of the allowance assignment in approve.
_value is stored directly as the spender allowance by approve.
_owner is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
The cached local allowance is the value that is later decremented in the unchecked allowance subtraction.
